column4: Dice - Desktop 1440px, 195x277 leaf, no children. THE ONE FRAME IN THIS SECTION COMPARED BY EYE: a render of this node was pulled and set beside the shipped raster, and both are the same two white-and-grey dice tumbling on mint green - not the orange dice on fire the hub drew before the 2026-08-19 sweep. Shipped dice-alt.webp, sized on disk this pass at 1856x2304; playGameArt.ts:827 wires it with accent #138462, the stop this node declares at 78.7%, and /play/dice draws the same file. Drawn at lg:w-[195px] on aspect-[274/388] = 195x276.13 against the node's 277, and exactly at lg:h-[277px] lg:w-[195px] on the game page's hero card. No browser ran.
